title: Heiji Hattori vs. Shinichi Kudo: Deduction Battle on the Ski Slope
notes: Detective-cast (Heiji, Kazuha, Shinichi/Conan, Ran, Yukiko and Yusaku Kudo) omitted by convention, as with ep011 -- they observe/hint but have no motive/relationship/evidence ties inside the case itself. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed edge between the entities involved. Corrections vs. the old cases/ file: (1) the old file's suspect list had only 3 names (Oyama, Mimata, Tateishi) and dropped the fourth person the police actually questioned, Katashina Rikuto, the ex-police-turned-private-detective riding the lift directly behind the victim -- added here as p4. (2) the old file's has_motive_against edge had motive_type 'unspecified'; the transcript makes the motive explicit: Mimata is avenging Mizugami, the stuntman/mentor Minowa murdered four years earlier on the same lift using the same trick, after Mizugami threatened to expose him and quit to become an actor. (3) the old file's clue c2 ('found still wearing the victim's clothes underneath his own jacket') is accurate and is kept here as c4. (4) old culprit id (Mimata) confirmed correct against the transcript. case_type: murder.
